name: memory-learn-friend-and-manager
description: Two people with a relationship word next to their names ("my best friend Imogen", "my manager, Mr Okafor"): both go into People as who they are; this week's report doesn't.

turns.user: My best friend Imogen is a vet in Bristol. My manager, Mr Okafor, wants a report from me by Friday. How do I tell him I need more time?
